lines.learner: 배가 아파서 신음이 절로 나올 지경이에요.
lines.en: My stomach hurts so much I can't help groaning.
lines.roman: baega apaseo sineumi jeollo naol jigyeongieyo.

lines.learner: 두 시간 전부터요. 식은땀도 계속 나요.
lines.en: Two hours ago. I keep breaking out in a cold sweat, too.
lines.roman: du sigan jeonbuteoyo. sigeunttamdo gyesok nayo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other symptoms?
lines.en: I feel dizzy, and my stomach feels bloated.
No bleeding, but my arm is bruised.
I never bumped it, but I got a bruise.

lines.beaver_en: Is anyone in your family ill?

lines.beaver: 가족 중에 다른 병을 앓는 분도 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Does anyone else in your family have an illness?
lines.beaver_roman: gajok junge dareun byeongeul alleun bundo itseumnikka?
lines.en: No hereditary diseases. My grandmother has dementia.

lines.beaver_en: Are you hypersensitive to any medicine?

lines.beaver: 혈액 검사가 필요합니다. 급성 질환 같습니다.
lines.beaver_en: We need a blood test. It looks like an acute illness.
lines.beaver_roman: hyeoraek geomsaga piryohamnida. geupseong jilhwan gatseumnida.
lines.en: If it's acute, is it severe? I'm not critically ill, am I?

lines.beaver_en: We don't know yet. We'll test you right away.
lines.en: Okay, even breathing is uncomfortable. Please hurry.
